title: URL Shortener
description: Build a URL shortener that generates short codes, stores URL mappings, resolves shortened URLs, and tracks click counts.

steps.title: Generate a random short code

hints: Loop 'length' times, picking a random character each iteration

steps.title: Create the URL store
steps.description: Define a `urlStore` object that maps short codes to long URLs. Add a few sample entries and log the store.
hints: Add at least 3 entries with different short codes

codeTemplate.python:
import json

urlStore = {
  "abc123": "https://example.com/very-long-url-page-1",
  "def456": "https://example.com/another-long-url",
  "ghi789": "https://example.com/yet-another-one"
}

print("Store entries:", len(urlStore))
print(json.dumps(urlStore))

verification.successMessage: URL store is set up with code-to-URL mappings!
verification.failureMessage: Create a urlStore object with at least 3 short code to URL mappings.

steps.title: Implement shortenUrl function
steps.description: Write a `shortenUrl` function that takes a long URL, generates a short code, stores the mapping, and returns the short code. Log the result.
hints: Generate a short code using generateShortCode()
Return the short code and log: 'Short URL: ' + shortCode

verification.successMessage: URLs can be shortened with a generated code stored in the mapping!
verification.failureMessage: shortenUrl should generate a code, store urlStore[code] = longUrl, log 'Short code: <code>', and return the code.

steps.title: Implement resolveUrl function
steps.description: Write a `resolveUrl` function that takes a short code and returns the original long URL. Log a success or error message.
hints: If found: return the URL and log: 'Resolved to: ' + url
If not found: log 'Code not found!' and return null

steps.title: Track click count per URL
steps.description: Create a `clickCounts` object to track how many times each short code is accessed. Modify `resolveUrl` to increment the count. Log the click counts.
hints: Before resolving, initialize if not exists: clickCounts[shortCode] = (clickCounts[shortCode] || 0) + 1
Log click counts: 'Clicks for ' + shortCode + ': ' + clickCounts[shortCode]

verification.successMessage: Click counts are tracked for each short code!
verification.failureMessage: After resolving 'abc123' three times, clickCounts['abc123'] should be 3.
